objective: Neural Network RTLをhybridで実行し、CPU実行よりどれぐらい早くなるのか、どのようなテストベンチなら早くなるのかを調査する

success_criteria.requirement: Run real neural-network accelerator RTL through the hybrid path.
Compare CPU execution against hybrid execution with coverage-output equivalence.
Quantify how much faster hybrid is than CPU.

evidence.nvdla_cmac_a2cacc: six shapes passed; maximum CPU-to-hybrid-wall speedup 11764.742765273311x
evidence.nvdla_cmac_core_mac_flat: five first compute shapes passed; 1x64 was slower at 0.133671475441474x, while state-parallel shapes were faster
evidence.nvdla_cmac_core_mac_state_parallel: three additional state-parallel shapes passed; speedup range 15.288825334405816x to 310.9863588667366x
evidence.pulp_ita_dotp: three shapes passed; speedup range 0.5756171840517875x to 1431.55023923445x
evidence.pulp_ita_softmax_top: three shapes passed; speedup range 0.9760930159724396x to 943.6308724832215x

success_criteria.requirement: Identify which testbench shapes are fast.
success_criteria.evidence: State-parallel many-state shapes are consistently fast; minimum-overhead 1x1 can be faster but fixed-overhead dominated; single-state repeated-launch shapes are weak or slower.

success_criteria.requirement: Preserve non-claims and distinguish scoped RTL-seed results from full modern NN execution.

prompt_to_artifact_checklist.prompt_item: CPU実行よりどれぐらい早いか
prompt_to_artifact_checklist.verified_by: CPU elapsed, hybrid GPU-event time, hybrid wall time, and speedup ratios

prompt_to_artifact_checklist.prompt_item: どのテストベンチなら早いか
prompt_to_artifact_checklist.verified_by: shape classifications across NVDLA and PULP ITA

prompt_to_artifact_checklist.prompt_item: 現在の最新NNに足りない物を調査
prompt_to_artifact_checklist.verified_by: modern NN gap notes: attention, softmax, KV-cache, low precision, MoE/GQA/MQA/speculative decoding, modern graph/model ingestion

covered_scope: NVDLA CNN-era routing and CMAC datapath seeds
PULP ITA attention-score dot-product datapath seed
PULP ITA integer softmax/reduction datapath seed
CPU-vs-hybrid wall-time classification for smoke, state-parallel, and single-state repeated shapes
residual_non_claims: not broad speedup beyond measured RTL seeds
